verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms Granola publishes an llms.txt at docs.granola.ai that returns HTTP 200 and indexes its docs and help center. The help-center pages are themselves served as markdown (.md) URLs that an agent can fetch directly. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of agents consuming these docs, evidence of a full-content variant (e.g. llms-full.txt) or other dedicated agent-oriented guidance.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://docs.granola.ai/llms.txt # Granola Docs & Help Center
